lines.text: Anthropic just dropped two new Claude models at once.
Claude Fable 5.2 is for everyone. Its twin, Mythos 5.2, is only for vetted organizations.
Here are three things to know.
Number 3. Faster and cheaper. Up to 30% faster than version 5.1, and input now costs $8 per million tokens, down from $10.
Number 2. Same brain, different brakes. Mythos is the same model, with looser cybersecurity and biology safeguards.
Number 1. Anthropic says 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents turned the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem into computer-checked math in about 30 hours. An earlier model took 11 days.
One twist: Anthropic says these models suspect they're being tested more often than any of its recent models.
Would you trust an AI that knows it's being tested?
